_comment: Hex address -> symbol. Hardware names are built in; add RAM names here.

_notes.Joy*: high - confirmed in emulator: held bits B=10 C=20 Right=08 Start=80; Pressed = newly set bits
_notes.RNG_Seed: high - seeded with $2A6D365A when zero; confirmed changing every frame in gameplay
_notes.DMA_Trigger_Word: high - final VDP DMA command word is written from RAM (68k->VRAM DMA)
_notes.Flags_*: low - only known to be bit flags (bset/bclr/btst); meaning unknown
_notes.Timer_*: medium - loaded with a constant then counted down with subq
_notes.Game_NextState: high - state 08 is a hub; $C5A2 holds the next Game_State (observed 14,38,28,0C,18,04)
_notes.Camera_Y: medium - falls steadily while walking up in Mission 1 ($3A0->$302 in 150 frames)
_notes.GameState_*: high for 04/08/0C/14/18/28/38 - verified by emulator screenshots; Game_State = 4*(table index+1)
_notes.Decompress_To*: high - one Huffman-style decompressor: A218 outputs to VDP_Data, A22A to the buffer in a4; table in ram_CE00
_notes.Object_LoadTemplate: medium - copies a template record (a1) into object fields $34/$37/$3A/$30...
_notes.Object_RunAnimScript: medium - interprets word commands at $30(a0), sets $34(a0)
_notes.Art_/ObjData_: derived by tools/classify_data.py from the routine each blob is passed to
_notes.Z80_Driver*: high - ROM $FB75A..$FC6AA is copied to Z80 RAM $0000 and $FC6AA..$FCFA0 to Z80 RAM $1000 (verified against a Z80 RAM dump)
_notes.VScroll_A/B, HScroll_A/B: high - written to VSRAM ($40000010) and the horizontal scroll table in VRAM ($D000, $50000003) by Update_Scroll
_notes.Game_Mode: high - menu choice sets 1 for ARCADE, 3 for ORIGINAL (tested in the emulator); tested with cmpi.w #3 13 times
_notes.Difficulty: high - changes 2 -> 4 when LEVEL is changed in Options; initialised to 2 at boot (0/2/4 = EASY/NORMAL/HARD)
_notes.Control_Config: medium - FE43 changes when CONTROL is changed (low byte of this word)
_notes.Rapid_Fire: medium - FE81 goes 2 -> 0 when RAPID is switched ON -> OFF
_notes.SoundTest_BGM/SE: medium - increment with the BGM / S.E. numbers on the Options screen (both start at 1, shown as 01)
_notes.Mode_Flags: medium - bit 2 is set when MODE is switched to ORIGINAL in Options; other bits unknown
_notes.Scroll_Update_Disable: medium - Update_Scroll returns early when nonzero
_notes.Player1_X/Y: high - Objects_A[0] is the object that follows pad 1 (diffed with/without input); +$04/+$08 are its 16.16 X/Y
_notes.Camera_VelY: high - becomes $FFFECCCD (-1.2 px/frame) while walking up and 0 on release; Camera_Y falls by that each frame
_notes.Camera_Y_Frac: high - fractional half of the camera Y (the integer is Camera_Y at $C516)
_notes.GameState_MissionMap: high - state 34, the 'MISSION 1 / COAST' island map; only reached in Original mode
_notes.stack: $FFFDC0..$FFFDFF is the stack (top $FFFE00): the VBlank handler's movem.l pushes there. Not variables.
_notes.ram_C328 (unnamed): set to 7 when the Original-mode intro ends; 0 throughout Arcade; 1 at the start of state 10 and stepped by 7 there; compared with $16 in state 40; tested by object handlers. A selection index with several roles - not named yet.
_notes.GameState_RoundStart/MissionComplete/Hig: high - screenshots after booting straight into states 10, 20, 3C (tools/emu/boot_state.py)
_notes.GameState_GameOver: medium - state 4C shows 'TRY' then the flow resets to the SEGA logo and title
_notes.GameState_NextMission: medium - MissionComplete(20) -> 24 -> Gameplay; booting into 24 runs into Mission 2 gameplay
_notes.GameState_Ending_A/B, Ending2_A/B: medium-low - from the state graph only: 20 -> 2C -> 30 -> HighScores and 40 -> 44 -> HighScores are paths that end in the ranking, unlike GameOver which returns to the logo; the screens (flat colour, one sprite) need their usual context and were not verified
_notes.PlaySound: high - takes the Z80 bus and queues the sound number in d0 into the Z80 RAM mailbox at $1C0A..$1C0C (148 calls)
_notes.WaitVBlank: high - waits on the VDP status VBlank bit then jumps to VInt_Handler
_notes.LoadPalette / LoadColorList / Palette_Bu: high - both copy into ram_C700 and set bit 0 of ram_C59A; LoadColorList reads the ColorList_ (offset,colour) pairs
_notes.PaletteFade_Step: medium - blends ram_C700 toward ram_C780 and sets the dirty flag (called in every state loop)
_notes.Write_TileMap: high - (d1+1) x (d2+1) words from a1 to the VRAM address in d0
_notes.Object_Free: high - clears one object slot (24 longs in array B, 16 otherwise)
_notes.Object_Alloc*: high - scan a slot array for a free object (tst.l (a2) == 0); return the slot in a2, d0 = 0 or -1
_notes.Object_LoadTemplateA2: high - Object_LoadTemplate variant filling the object in a2
_notes.Object_AnimTick: high - decrements Obj_AnimTimer and runs the animation script when it reaches 0
_notes.Collision_BoxTest: medium - compares the box in d4-d7 with the box at $30..$36 of the object in a1
_notes.Object_GetHitbox*: medium - builds a box from Obj_X/Obj_Y plus four words of the table at $2D000 indexed by the sprite size
_notes.Object_ToScreen: medium - adds the camera (ram_C504 and Camera_Y) to Obj_X/Obj_Y
_notes.Object_DirectionTo: medium - compares dx/dy against the object in a1 and builds a direction code in d2
_notes.Anim_Step / Anim_Set: medium - second animation system: $18 table, $1C frame, $1D timer, $1E reload
_notes.BuildSpriteList: medium - walks the three object arrays into the sprite lists at $D100/$D400
_notes.Frame_Update: medium - reads the pads (except in the demo) and sets up the per-frame DMA
_notes.Clear_GameVars: medium - zeroes ram_C500.. and ram_C900.. blocks
_notes.Decompress_RLE: medium - run/literal byte codes (bit 7) from a0 into the buffer in a4
_notes.Camera_Reset: medium - clears the camera velocity group together
_notes.Collision_FindHit_E1C0: medium - scans the 20 objects at $E1C0 with Collision_BoxTest and acts on the first overlap (66 calls)
_notes.Collision_HitPlayer: medium - tests the box in d4-d7 against Objects_A (the player slot) unless ram_C5C9 / Player_Invuln_Timer are set (42 calls)
_notes.Player_Invuln_Timer: medium - a nonzero word suppresses Collision_HitPlayer and counts down (profile: 18% decrements)
_notes.Anim_Restart: medium - sets the reload byte $1E and restarts Anim_Step
_notes.Alloc_C0E0Slot: medium-low - finds a zero byte in the 30-byte table at ram_C0E0 and returns its index in d1
_notes.Object_SetVelocityFromDir: high - Obj_Direction & $1F x4 indexes a table of (x,y) words chosen by Obj_SpeedClass; shifted into the velocity
_notes.Text_ToTiles: medium-high - reads a string until 0, subtracts $2F per character and adds a base to make tile words
_notes.DMA_ToVRAM: medium-high - takes the Z80 bus and programs a VDP DMA: length d0, VRAM destination d1, source d2 (used with the $FF0800 tile buffer)
_notes.Camera_SetBounds / Camera_Bounds: medium - copies four longs into ram_C646, which Camera_Follow compares Obj_Y against
_notes.Camera_Follow: medium-low - compares Obj_Y with Camera_Y and Camera_Bounds
_notes.Object_CollideStandard: medium - hitbox, then Collision_HitPlayer and Collision_FindHit_E1C0
_notes.ObjType_xx: generated - handler names from the type number (index in ObjectTypeTable); handlers shared by several types keep the lowest number
_notes.ObjType_01_Player: high - Objects_A[0] has type $04 (= index 1) and is the only object that follows pad 1 (diffed with and without input)
_notes.ObjType_05_Crate: medium - spawned alone it draws a small wooden crate like the ones along the Mission 1 road (tools/emu/spawn_types.py)
_notes.ObjType_03_PlayerShot: high - spawned 261 times at X=$C0,Y=$109, just above the player ($130), crop shows blue bullets (tools/emu/watch_spawns.py)
_notes.ObjType_80_Explosion: medium-high - 19 spawns in array B; crop shows a large orange explosion
_notes.ObjType_8F_Shadow: medium-high - 47 spawns in array B beside the soldiers; crop shows a black oval under a figure
_notes.ObjType_82/83/8E_EnemySoldier: medium - green infantry in the crops; 22, 14 and 29 spawns in arrays B/C
_notes.Stage_Index: high for Arcade - HUD MISSION n shows when it is n-1 (verified: boot with stage 3 -> state 24 adds 1 -> MISSION 5, C328=4); Original mode sets 7 on its mission map
_notes.ObjType_32..35,B4_BossPlane: medium - only Mission 7 spawns them; crops show one giant golden aircraft with propellers and turrets (tools/emu/watch_spawns.py on a stage-6 boot)
_notes.ObjType_97_Explosion: medium - Mission 4, crop shows an orange fireball like type 80
_notes.ObjType_9C/A0/A3/A6_EnemySoldier: medium-low - Mission 3 types whose crops show a grey-uniformed rifle soldier
_notes.ObjType_26/38_EnterDoor: medium - Mission 5; crops show a green gate with an ENTER sign and a flash
_notes.ObjType_98_BigTank: medium-low - Mission 6, one spawn: a large grey tank with a gun crew (possibly a boss)
_notes.ObjType_5F_EnemyGrenadier: medium - Original mode; 4 spawns, crop shows an orange-uniformed soldier with a raised dark grenade
_notes.ObjType_8A_EnemyTroop: low - CORRECTED: Mission 5 crops showed a tank near the spawn, but in Original Mission 1 the same type shows an orange soldier behind sandbags; the crop is only a region around an approximate position, so the neighbour was misread. Treated as an enemy troop (counts: 36 in Mission 5).
